coordinates.note: Area-weighted centroid of the OpenStreetMap building footprint (about 80 m by 150 m), computed 2026-10-26; campus-grade approximate point for the building that houses the pulsed muon and neutron facilities, not a beamline or experimental-hall position (rank-11 OpenStreetMap source, A17).

name: J-PARC Materials and Life Science Experimental Facility (MLF)
notes: The J-PARC map (map:j-parc) records that the MLF had no atlas entity of its own; this site is the first one.

summary.plain: The J-PARC building in Tokai, Ibaraki, that houses the pulsed muon and neutron beams used for materials, life-science and particle-physics experiments such as the muon g-2/EDM experiment.
summary.technical: J-PARC MLF (3 GeV RCS-fed muon and neutron facility, surface building); hosts the muon beamlines used by the J-PARC muon g-2/EDM experiment (H line, H2 area) and DeeMe. Location is the OSM building centroid, approximate.
